purpose: Feature-only data-schedule repair after the v1 exact-nonzero presence label and fixed route-condition camera schedule produced a confirmed cross-route shortcut.

reference_data.source: frozen B2D route-disjoint observation feature selection

target.persistent_magnitude: absolute log ratio of observed/reference patch feature RMS
target.transient: absolute difference between observed and reference consecutive-frame cosine residuals
target.future_support_auxiliary: only target-derived high-response or soft-amplitude support frozen after v2 target audit

intervention_split.optimizer_views: deterministic four-frame window cycle over camera views
intervention_split.route_validation: same optimizer families on five disjoint B2D validation routes
intervention_split.heldout_family_development: local_glare on validation and held-out B2D routes
intervention_split.native_development: existing exact-pose Epic fog on Town01/Route146 and Town04/Route203

view_schedule.offset: sha256(seed, route_id, family, severity) modulo six
view_schedule.rationale: preserve short temporal sensor continuity while preventing one route/family/severity key from labeling one camera for all 16 frames

projected_schedule_audit.assumption: the frozen selector takes each route's first 16-frame contiguous run; extraction rechecks actual metadata before saving
projected_schedule_audit.runtime_gate: every actual route/family/severity sequence must cover at least four views before the shard is saved

required_after_extraction: train-only continuous-target amplitude and spatial-support audit
verify responsive footprint is no longer used as a presence label
freeze a separate adapter architecture and loss smoke
